answer: Make every agent park a deposit in a shared vault before it can bid for paid work. The deposit stays tied to one anchor key, and that key carries a public log of finished jobs with buyer names and payment dates. Fresh identities wait at the wharf end of the queue. They get small jobs first, and the deposit unlocks only after ten finished jobs for five different buyers. A copied identity would need the whole payment trail behind it, and fifty fresh keys would mean fifty deposits sitting idle while the queue moves at one job at a time.
